# Pure Air California

> Inspection-led residential and commercial air duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, HVAC system component cleaning, and electrostatic air filter service across Greater Los Angeles, California.

## Verified Business Identity
- Legal name: Pure Air California (PAC)
- Website: https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/
- Local phone: (213) 792-4145 (`+1-213-792-4145`)
- Toll-free phone: (877) 877-8745
- Email: lou@pureaircalifornia.com
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=4164883086478915552
- Business model: Service-area business serving Greater Los Angeles (Los Angeles County and parts of Ventura County). Neighborhood pages describe local service coverage, not walk-in branch offices.
- Philosophy: EPA-aligned, condition-based inspection before cleaning; written scope and pricing confirmed before work starts; no medical, allergy-cure, or asthma-prevention claims.

## Published Starting Pricing
- Residential air duct cleaning: starts at **$299** for eligible residential scopes.
- Residential dryer vent cleaning: starts at **$149** for eligible residential scopes.
- Final written estimates vary by system count, attic/crawlspace or roof access, duct condition, vent routing, and included components.
- Multi-system homes, commercial buildings, HOAs, and wildfire-smoke assessments receive individual written proposals.
- Full pricing guide: https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/pricing/
- Request a free estimate: https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/quote/

## Core Services
- [All Services Directory](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/): Complete residential, commercial, and HOA service catalog.
- [Home Services Guide](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/home-services/): Residential air duct, dryer vent, HVAC component, and filter care in Greater Los Angeles.
- [Residential Air Duct Cleaning](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/residential-air-duct-cleaning/): Negative-pressure source removal for accessible home supply/return ducts, registers, and trunks (starting at $299 for eligible scopes).
- [Residential Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/residential-dryer-vent-cleaning/): Full-path lint extraction and airflow verification from laundry connection to exterior wall or roof hood (starting at $149 for eligible scopes).
- [Commercial Air Duct Cleaning](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/commercial-air-duct-cleaning/): Building-specific ventilation cleaning for LA offices, hotels, clinics, restaurants, schools, retail, and industrial spaces.
- [Commercial & HOA Air Duct + Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/commercial-hoa-air-duct-dryer-vent-cleaning-los-angeles/): Coordinated multi-unit dryer exhaust stacks, common-area HVAC, resident scheduling, and written closeout records.
- [Wildfire Smoke & Hillside Air Duct Assessment](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/wildfire-smoke-hillside-air-duct-cleaning-los-angeles/): Inspection-led assessment and source removal for smoke particulate, ash, and renovation dust (not fire-restoration clearance or guaranteed odor removal).
- [Commercial Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/commercial-dryer-vent-cleaning/): Multi-unit laundry room, hotel, and commercial exhaust riser/manifold cleaning.
- [Laundromat Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/laundromat-dryer-vent-cleaning/): High-volume dryer bank, shared manifold trunk, booster fan, and roof termination clearing.
- [HVAC System Cleaning](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/hvac-system-cleaning/): Accessible evaporator coils, blower assemblies, air handlers, plenums, and connected ductwork.
- [Dryer Vent Maintenance Program](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/dryer-vent-maintenance-program/): Recurring dryer exhaust inspection and lint removal plans for homes, HOAs, and commercial properties.
- [Residential Electrostatic Air Filter Service](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/residential-electrostatic-filter/): Collector-cell cleaning, sizing check, and maintenance for compatible home filters.
- [Commercial Electrostatic Air Filter Service](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/commercial-electrostatic-filter/): Scheduled collector-cell and filter-bank maintenance for commercial HVAC equipment.
- [Air Duct Sanitizing Assessment](https://www.pureaircalifornia.com/services/air-duct-sanitizing/): Material-compatibility and label-based assessment after mechanical source removal.
